solutions.title: Memoized Catalan recursion
solutions.strategy: Memoize counts by number of nodes and sum each possible root split.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each size computes n split products across all sizes.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The memo table stores one count per size.

solutions.title: Bottom-up Catalan DP
solutions.strategy: Build counts for sizes from zero to n.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every size tries every left-subtree size.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP array stores n plus one counts.
